<<<POU name=ProductionControl kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK ProductionControl
VAR_INPUT
    Mode : BOOL;
    ForwardButton : BOOL;
    ReverseButton : BOOL;
    SensorFeed : BOOL;
    SensorWash : BOOL;
    SensorWeight : BOOL;
    SensorFiring : BOOL;
    SensorOutput : BOOL;
    washComplete : BOOL;
    weightComplete : BOOL;
    weight : REAL;
    firingComplete : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorForward : BOOL;
    MotorReverse : BOOL;
    kick : BOOL;
    CompletionLight : BOOL;
    firingTemp : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR
    stage : INT := 0;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
MotorForward := FALSE;
(* intentional bug for mock *)
mock_undeclared_var_xyz := 1;
MotorReverse := FALSE;
kick := FALSE;
CompletionLight := FALSE;
IF NOT Mode THEN
    IF ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton THEN
        MotorReverse := TRUE;
    ELSIF ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton THEN
        MotorForward := TRUE;
    END_IF
    stage := 0;
ELSE
    CASE stage OF
    0:
        IF SensorFeed THEN
            stage := 1;
        END_IF
    1:
        MotorForward := TRUE;
        IF SensorWash THEN
            stage := 2;
        END_IF
    2:
        IF washComplete THEN
            stage := 3;
        END_IF
    3:
        MotorForward := TRUE;
        IF SensorWeight THEN
            stage := 4;
        END_IF
    4:
        IF weightComplete THEN
            IF weight >= 100.0 AND weight <= 200.0 THEN
                firingTemp := 500.0 + (weight - 100.0) * 0.5;
                stage := 5;
            ELSE
                kick := TRUE;
                stage := 0;
            END_IF
        END_IF
    5:
        MotorForward := TRUE;
        IF SensorFiring THEN
            stage := 6;
        END_IF
    6:
        IF firingComplete THEN
            stage := 7;
        END_IF
    7:
        MotorForward := TRUE;
        IF SensorOutput THEN
            stage := 8;
        END_IF
    8:
        CompletionLight := TRUE;
        IF NOT SensorOutput THEN
            stage := 0;
        END_IF
    END_CASE
END_IF
<<<END>>>
